description:
Education Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
 Work Experience Requirements:
 A minimum of three (3) years of progressive work experience in software development including webMethods, JMS and Universal Messaging, Java development tools, and Agile.
 Demonstrated experience with enterprise data integration technologies, ESB (WebMethods, etc.), other messaging oriented middleware.
 Should be a Self-starter.
 Strong SDLC, project management, time management, and tracking/reporting skills.
 
 3 years of PROFESSIONAL experience in the U.S.
 3 years of professional   WebMethods experience 
 MUST HAVE:   Publish Subscribe Model in Webmethods . Some call it   Pub Sub . This is 85% of the job
 JSON – must have but she said they should have that 
 **CICD from WebMethods- Nice to have
 There are 7 WebMethods developers on her team and 3 database developers. Since the webmethods is the Middleware they will able working closely with the database people as well as the web and mobile teams.
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
